thread:
Michael (Sales): heads-up — onboarding call with Acme Health scheduled tomorrow. they're asking for an on-prem POC and want the platform fee waived for 90 days. can we do that?
Tara (SE): what's the size of the commit if they convert? any reserved months or GPUs planned?
Michael (Sales): current ask is POC only: 2-node onprem, evaluation for 3 months, likely 6–12 month commit after. ARR is uncertain; customer asked for written support tier / pricing exceptions before POC.
Tara (SE): okay. for onprem we normally require the platform fee + enterprise support. waiving platform fee is a big exception. can we propose a reduced platform fee instead? e.g., 50% for the POC period, then full fee on conversion.
Jordan (DealDesk): ping — need numbers. what's the standard platform fee and support tier we would attach?
Michael (Sales): standard onprem platform fee = $15k/month. enterprise support (Gold) = $6k/month.
Jordan (DealDesk): so baseline is $21k/mo. If we do 50% platform fee for 3 months, that's $7.5k x 3 = $22.5k less than baseline. we need a business justification (ARR, strategic value) for a formal exception.
Anjali (CISO): also raised a security questionnaire gap: they require HSM-based key storage and SOC2 Type II evidence for our private package — flagged as blocker for POC. timeline for HSM integration?
Tara (SE): HSM integration is possible in Private but typically needs the onprem package + infra changes; delivery lead time ~4–6 weeks. for POC we can offer a scoped doc review and temporary customer-controlled KMS in their VPC.
Priya (Legal): for any fee waiver we need a short amendment to the MSA specifying POC scope, liability caps, and an acceptance criteria for the POC. also add an exit clause if they don't convert.
Michael (Sales): suggested commercial: reduce platform fee to $7.5k/mo for 3 months, keep Gold support full, require a technical acceptance checklist and a 90-day conversion right with a minimum 6-mo commit at standard rates if they convert. does that sound approvable?
Jordan (DealDesk): initial reaction — acceptable if we get: (1) customer agrees to conversion terms in advance, (2) legal signs the POC amendment, (3) security sign-off on temporary KMS approach. I'll need to log this as an exception and route to revenue ops for sign-off.
Anjali (CISO): temporary KMS in customer VPC is fine for the POC, but we must not hold keys. add checklist item: encryption-at-rest validated and HSM roadmap with dates.
Tara (SE): I'll draft a minimal acceptance checklist (deploy steps, perf targets, KV cache validity, data handling notes) and upload to the deal thread.
Michael (Sales): thanks. Jordan — can you confirm if 50% platform reduction for 3 months triggers any discounts cap we can't exceed?
Jordan (DealDesk): our discount cap for onprem is 40% without SVP approval. 50% would need SVP sign-off. alternatively, if we keep discount to 40% and add a one-time onboarding credit, that might be faster.
Michael (Sales): ok — option A: 40% platform fee off for 3 months + $10k onboarding credit. Option B: 50% off for 3 months but requires SVP approval. which route do you prefer to push?
Jordan (DealDesk): push Option A for faster turnaround. I'll prepare the exception form and route to revenue ops. if they push back, we can escalate for SVP approval.
Priya (Legal): share draft POC amendment with me once the checklist is up. I'll fast-track review but need to confirm indemnities and data processing terms.
Tara (SE): checklist draft uploaded: `POC_acceptance_acme_v1.md` (link) — includes perf SLAs: p99 < 600ms for inference on 2-node setup, and KV cache pre-warm steps.
Michael (Sales): shared with customer in meeting notes. they responded: "sounds reasonable, need written confirmation on support coverage and proof of SOC2 before we sign."
Anjali (CISO): I'll attach our SOC2 summary and a short note on the HSM roadmap. not full report, but sufficient for POC.
Jordan (DealDesk): created exception ticket #DD-2026 with Option A terms. ETA for approval routing: 24–48 hours.
deploy-bot: Deployment request recorded: POC checklist artifact added to deal CR-1145.
Michael (Sales): great — keeping this thread updated. next steps: Jordan files exception, Priya drafts amendment, Tara finalizes checklist, Anjali provides SOC2/roadmap. I'll confirm once customer signs. :thumbsup:
